c.terms: For further details on the information presented in this Plan Information Document, or for full terms and conditions, please visit www.engie.com.au or call ENGIE on 13 88 08. All time-dependent rates (eg. 4pm to 8pm) are billed in AEST.

discounts.description: You'll receive a 1% guaranteed discount off our electricity usage and supply charges.

c.variation: We may vary your rates and charges at any time, including if any underlying information is incorrect, you get a new meter or your distributor changes your tariff. We'll give you advance notice of any change, which may be on your bill.

incentives.description: If you're a new or moving customer, you'll also receive a $220 Join & Stay Credit on your electricity bill. Once you've been on your plan for 90 days, your credits will appear on the next issued bill.

eligibility.description: You must have, or be in the process of, installing a solar system with a maximum inverter size of 10kW and not be receiving a feed-in tariff under a government scheme.

solarFeedInTariff.description: 10c/kWh for the first 8kWh per day of solar export,
And 3c/kWh thereafter, based on a daily average over your billing period.

c.onExpiryDescription: Ongoing energy plan until you or we end it. We may end this energy plan at any time by giving you 20 Business Days' notice.
